region: Sichuan, Qinghai and Gansu: the Tibetan plateau edge and the Silk Road
title: China — West: From Sichuan's Tibetan Highlands Along the Silk Road to Dunhuang
subtitle: Kham grassland, Amdo monasteries and the Gansu corridor in 15 days
summary: A 15-day route from Chengdu through Tibetan Sichuan, Qinghai and Gansu to the Mogao Caves, with hired drivers and high-speed trains. Security is conditional because of access restrictions in Tibetan areas and visa-free entry ending on 31 December 2026.
introduction: The route starts with pandas and hot pot in Chengdu, then climbs by road to Kangding and the grassland at Tagong, 3,700 m up, before dropping into the stone-tower villages of Danba. A flight to Xining leads to Kumbum Monastery and the Amdo Tibetan valley of Rebgong, ending in Xiahe at Labrang Monastery. From Lanzhou the group takes the high-speed train through the Hexi corridor: Zhangye's striped sandstone at sunrise, the Great Wall's west end at Jiayuguan, and Dunhuang's Mogao Caves and dunes. No Tibet permit or self-drive is needed.

exceptional.vsOman: Oman is driven independently, in a rented car with tents. This route cannot be: foreign licences are invalid in China, camping is impractical in March, and the group is carried by hired vans and trains. It adds monasteries with living pilgrim circuits and a 1,600-year-old cave gallery.
exceptional.vsPackageTourism: Package tours go to Chengdu, Xi'an and Beijing, or to Dunhuang from Lanzhou. This route spends four nights in Tibetan Sichuan and two in Xiahe, on the Kham and Amdo sides of the plateau, in family guesthouses that tours seldom use.
exceptional.vsPortfolio: D03 Yunnan covers the south-west Tibetan fringe and minority towns; no other trip combines Tibetan Buddhism at 3,700 m with the Silk Road caves and a rail line along the Great Wall.

coordinates.label: Eastern Tibetan plateau and Hexi corridor

duration.note: Day 1 departure and Day 15 return from Beijing; Day 14 is a domestic flight day with a night near Beijing airport.

recommendedTravelWindow.rationale: The Spring Festival rush and Losar closures are over, and the 10, 14 and 16 March anniversaries are past; Gansu is still cold but the high passes are open and Mogao is in low season.

februarySuitability.summary: Spring Festival (5 to 13 February) packs trains and flights and shuts shops; Losar around 7 February and Labrang's Monlam are exactly when Ganzi may be closed to foreigners; Dunhuang is at about -10 degC at night.

marchSuitability.summary: Cold at altitude (nights to -8 degC at Tagong) but roads and trains run normally, hotels have rooms and Dunhuang's tourism is light; the main risk is a sandstorm or a snowfall on the Tagong road.

climate.regionNote: Planning ranges across Chengdu (500 m), Kangding and Tagong (2,560 and 3,700 m), Xining, Xiahe, Zhangye and Dunhuang. Chengdu, Xining and Dunhuang from China Highlights; Tagong, Kangding and Xiahe are altitude-based estimates.

february.rainfall: Dry on the plateau and in Gansu; light rain in Chengdu
february.humidity: Humid in Chengdu, very dry in Gansu
february.notes: Dunhuang about -10 to 5 degC; Xining 4 / -10 degC

march.rainfall: Light; occasional snow at altitude; sandstorms possible in Gansu
march.notes: Dunhuang 0 to 16 degC and windy; Xining 10 / -4 degC; Chengdu 15 / 10 degC

climate.snowAndMountainAccess: The Zheduo tunnel keeps the Kangding to Tagong road open in winter, but late snow and ice can slow it in March; the Xining to Xiahe road crosses hills and can ice over.
climate.airQuality: Chengdu and Lanzhou have urban pollution; the plateau and Dunhuang are clear.
climate.wildlifeSeasonality: Giant pandas are at the Chengdu base all year.

climate.ramadan2027: About 8 February to 9 March 2027; the window starts after Eid. Hui restaurants in Xining and Lanzhou are open in March; in February some close in the daytime.

climate.tourismDemand: Low in late March, except around holiday weekends; Mogao tickets still need booking.
climate.flightPriceSeasonality: Fares peak around Spring Festival and Qingming; mid to late March is shoulder season.

geography.summary: Chengdu basin, then the Hengduan edge of the plateau (Kangding, Tagong, Danba), Amdo river valleys around Xining and Xiahe, then the Hexi corridor between the Qilian Mountains and the Gobi to the Taklamakan edge at Dunhuang.
geography.distinctive: Within 15 days the route crosses 3,700 m grassland, Gyalrong stone-tower villages, the red-sandstone Danxia of the Qilian foothills and a dune field next to a 4th-century cave gallery.

landscapes.name: Tagong grassland
landscapes.description: Open pasture at 3,700 m under the 5,820 m Zhara Lhatse, with yaks and Khampa herders.

landscapes.name: Danba valley
landscapes.description: A gorge of the Dadu river with stone villages on terraced slopes.

landscapes.name: Zhangye Danxia
landscapes.description: Striped red and yellow sandstone hills, with boardwalks to viewing platforms.

landscapes.name: Mingsha Shan
landscapes.description: A high dune field near Dunhuang with a spring-fed lake at its foot.

culture.summary: Tibetan Buddhism in its Kham (Tagong, Danba) and Amdo (Rebgong, Xiahe) forms, Hui Muslim food in Xining, and the Silk Road Buddhist art of Dunhuang.

culturalHighlights.name: Lhagang Monastery (Tagong)
culturalHighlights.description: Sakya-order monastery with a Jowo image, surrounded by a pilgrim circuit.

culturalHighlights.name: Gyalrong villages and watchtowers (Danba)
culturalHighlights.description: Stone houses and towers in the Danba valley; stay in a family guesthouse.

culturalHighlights.name: Labrang Monastery (Xiahe)
culturalHighlights.description: A working Gelug monastery founded in 1709, entered with a monastery guide, with pilgrims on its kora.

culturalHighlights.name: Kumbum (Ta'er) Monastery
culturalHighlights.description: Birthplace of Tsongkhapa with murals and butter sculptures.

culturalHighlights.name: Mogao Caves
culturalHighlights.description: About 490 painted caves cut between the 4th and 14th centuries on the Silk Road.

adventureHighlights.name: Altitude at Tagong
adventureHighlights.description: Sleeping at 3,700 m after a night at 2,560 m, with a descent to Danba as the safety valve.

adventureHighlights.name: Dawn kora and grassland walks
adventureHighlights.description: Walking pilgrim circuits in the cold at Tagong and Xiahe.

adventureHighlights.name: Mingsha dune climb
adventureHighlights.description: Walking up a sand ridge to a sunset viewpoint; camel optional.

signatureExperiences.title: Kham highlands: Tagong and the Danba towers
signatureExperiences.description: Three days from Kangding over the Zheduo tunnel to Lhagang Monastery at 3,700 m, then down to Gyalrong villages and stone towers at Danba.
signatureExperiences.whyDistinctive: Foreigners can go without a permit, but the region is lightly visited in March, and the altitude change in two days is the whole point.
signatureExperiences.howToOrganise: Hire a 7-seat van with driver in Chengdu for four days and a local guide in Danba; book family guesthouses that take foreigners; check closures a week before.
signatureExperiences.costNote: Four van days, two nights' share and guide, rough share per person

signatureExperiences.title: Labrang Monastery and the Xiahe kora
signatureExperiences.description: A guided visit of the monastery halls, then the 3 km kora among pilgrims, and a drive to Sangke grassland.
signatureExperiences.whyDistinctive: The largest working Tibetan monastery outside the TAR; no permit, and the Monlam festival is over by the March window.
signatureExperiences.location: Xiahe, Gannan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Gansu
signatureExperiences.howToOrganise: Walk from a guesthouse next to the monastery; join the monastery's guided tour at the ticket office and photograph only in permitted areas.

signatureExperiences.title: Mogao Caves and Mingsha dunes
signatureExperiences.description: A timed guided visit to selected painted caves in the morning, then a dune climb and Crescent Lake at sunset.
signatureExperiences.whyDistinctive: A cave gallery used for a thousand years, in March with a fraction of summer's crowds.
signatureExperiences.howToOrganise: Book the Mogao slot through the official WeChat reservation as soon as sales open for 29 March; use a passport, not a Chinese ID.
signatureExperiences.costNote: Mogao about CNY 140 (low season), Mingsha about CNY 110, optional camel

signatureExperiences.title: Zhangye Danxia at sunrise and the Great Wall's western gate
signatureExperiences.description: First light on striped sandstone, then a high-speed train to Jiayuguan Fort and the Overhanging Great Wall.
signatureExperiences.whyDistinctive: Two stops on the Hexi corridor reached by high-speed train in a single day.
signatureExperiences.howToOrganise: Book a car from Zhangye for 5:30 on the morning of Day 11, then train to Jiayuguan.

travelStyle.summary: Hired van with driver on the Sichuan and Qinghai road days, then high-speed trains and flights; no self-drive.

transport.summary: Flights into Chengdu and out of Beijing; one domestic flight each way inside China; hired vans in the plateau; high-speed trains from Lanzhou through Zhangye and Jiayuguan to Dunhuang.

modes.description: 7-seat van with driver at CNY 800 to 1,200 a day including fuel; drivers know checkpoint routines.
Lanzhou West to Zhangye West, Zhangye to Jiayuguan South, Jiayuguan South to Dunhuang (2.5 h, CNY 109 second class).
Chengdu to Xining, Dunhuang to Beijing.

transport.carRental: Self-drive is not possible without a Chinese licence; use a hired driver booked through a local guesthouse or agent.

drivingRequirements.summary: Foreign licences and international permits are not valid in mainland China. A temporary Chinese permit exists but takes days of paperwork, and checkpoints plus winter roads make it a poor option.
drivingRequirements.internationalDrivingPermit: Not valid; a Chinese licence or temporary driving permit is needed.
drivingRequirements.licenceNotes: The two licensed travellers cannot drive; all road legs use hired drivers.
drivingRequirements.motorcycleNotes: No motorcycle riding; passengers only in a hired van.
drivingRequirements.recommendedApproach: Hired van with driver on road days and trains elsewhere.

accommodation.summary: Mid-range hotels in cities and family guesthouses in the Tibetan areas; hotels must be licensed for foreign guests.

camping.summary: Winter nights fall to -8 degC or lower on the plateau, and Tibetan areas have checkpoints that restrict stopping off-road.

physicalDifficulty.label: moderate
physicalDifficulty.summary: Short walks and long vehicle days; the demand comes from altitude at Tagong and Xiahe and from cold.

itinerary.summary: A 15-day loop from Chengdu through Ganzi to Xining, Xiahe and the Hexi corridor with flexible days 6 and 14.

days.title: Depart Paris
activities: Check in for the Chengdu flight; confirm the visa position before leaving (see practical requirements)
Carry layers in the cabin bag
days.practical: Chinese carriers normally include 23 kg checked baggage; flight times and the Air China schedule were not verified.

days.title: Pandas and a first Sichuan hot pot
activities: Arrive, metro or taxi to the hotel and drop bags
Giant panda base at opening hours when the animals are fed (about 7:30 to 10:30)
Afternoon walk and sleep; evening hot pot in a local restaurant
days.practical: Pick a mid-range hotel that is licensed to take foreigners (your booking platform will say so). Get the Alipay/WeChat Pay setup working on the first evening.

days.title: Up to the plateau edge
activities: Hired driver with a 7-seat van from Chengdu via the Ya'an-Kangding expressway
Check in to Kangding at 2,560 m and walk slowly in the afternoon
Early night: first night above 2,000 m
days.accommodation: Hotel or guesthouse in Kangding, 2 twin rooms
days.practical: Police checkpoints will log passports on the way; keep passports reachable. Drink water, no alcohol this evening.

days.title: Grassland and Lhagang Monastery at 3,700 m
activities: Drive through the Zheduo tunnel to Tagong
Walk the kora around Lhagang Monastery; Muya Golden Pagoda by car if time allows
Stay in a Tibetan family guesthouse
days.accommodation: Tibetan guesthouse in Tagong, 2 twin rooms
days.geographicalHighlight: Open grassland at 3,700 m under Zhara Lhatse
days.practical: Slowest day of the trip. If anyone has a headache or nausea, descend to Danba the same afternoon. Local access to Ganzi can be closed at short notice; see security notes.

days.title: Down to the Gyalrong valleys
activities: Drive to Danba (lower, about 1,900 m)
Afternoon visit of Zhonglu or Jiaju village and the stone watchtowers with a local guide
Night in a family guesthouse
days.culturalHighlight: Gyalrong Tibetan villages and stone towers
days.practical: Guide recommended for the village visit; do not photograph people or religious activity without asking.

days.title: Return to Chengdu (buffer day)
activities: Long drive back to Chengdu via the Dadu valley, Xiaojin and Wenchuan roads
If the Ganzi leg was closed or cut short, use the day for Leshan or Dujiangyan from Chengdu instead
days.practical: Flexible day: the Ganzi plan can lose a day to snow or a checkpoint without breaking the rest of the route.

days.title: Fly to Qinghai and Kumbum Monastery
activities: Morning flight to Xining (2,275 m)
Afternoon at Kumbum (Ta'er) Monastery, 25 km from the city
Evening in the Hui quarter around the Dongguan Mosque for lamb noodles and bread
days.practical: Qinghai has a list of counties closed to foreigners (France Diplomatie lists Xining itself, which is clearly out of date because hotels host foreigners); stay on the sites that the group has checked with the hotel.

days.title: Rebgong valley to Xiahe
activities: Drive south to Tongren and visit Rongwo or Longwu monastery and a thangka studio
Continue over the hills to Xiahe (2,900 m)
Evening kora around Labrang
days.practical: Long day; skip Tongren if the weather is bad and go straight to Xiahe (about 4 h). Ice is possible on the passes.

days.title: Labrang Monastery and the grassland
activities: Guided tour of Labrang halls (foreigners join a monastery guide)
Walk the 3 km kora with the prayer wheels
Afternoon by car to Sangke grassland
days.transport: Walk; hired driver for the grassland
days.practical: Winter hours are about 7:00 to 17:30. Monlam (first Tibetan month, about mid to late February) is finished by this window.

days.title: Drive to Lanzhou, then train to Zhangye
activities: Drive to Lanzhou West station (about 4 h)
High-speed train to Zhangye West (2 to 4.5 h depending on the train)
Dinner in Zhangye; book a driver for sunrise
days.practical: Buy train tickets on Trip.com or the 12306 app with your passport. Take an early train so the evening arrival is not late.

days.title: Danxia at sunrise, then Jiayuguan
activities: Early drive to Zhangye Danxia for first light and the boardwalks
Back to Zhangye for lunch
Afternoon high-speed train to Jiayuguan South; evening in town
days.travelTime: ≈ 1.5 h + 1 to 1.5 h + 1 h by train
days.practical: March mornings are around freezing: warm layers and gloves for the viewing platforms.

days.title: Jiayuguan Pass and the Silk Road train
activities: Morning at Jiayuguan Fort and the Overhanging Great Wall
Taxi to Jiayuguan South; train D2749 at 16:57 reaches Dunhuang at 19:26 (sample timetable, check)
Night market in Dunhuang
days.geographicalHighlight: Gobi plain below the Qilian Mountains
days.practical: Only two daytime D trains are listed; buy tickets as soon as booking opens (about two weeks ahead).

days.title: Mogao Caves and Mingsha dunes
activities: Morning timed visit of the Mogao Caves with the compulsory guide
Afternoon rest; late afternoon at Mingsha Shan and Crescent Lake; optional camel ride
Supper at the night market
days.culturalHighlight: Buddhist murals of the 4th to 14th centuries
days.practical: Book Mogao tickets as soon as the sales window opens; foreign passports use the official WeChat account. Wind and sandstorms are possible in March.

days.title: Fly out of the desert (buffer day)
activities: Free morning in Dunhuang, or use it for the Mogao reservation if it failed on Day 13
Afternoon flight to Beijing; hotel near the airport
days.accommodation: Airport hotel in Beijing, 2 twin rooms
days.practical: Flexible day: a missed Mogao ticket or a sandstorm can be absorbed here. Keep the Paris flight on the next morning, not the same day.

days.title: Fly home
activities: Morning flight Beijing to Paris; arrive the same afternoon
days.practical: Time difference: Paris is 7 h behind Beijing in March.

stops.name: Chengdu Tianfu International Airport
stops.description: Arrival airport, 55 km south-east of the city; direct Air China flights from Paris are reported but the frequency was not confirmed.
activities: Metro line 18 or taxi to the city
stops.transport: Airport express metro or taxi (about 1 h)

stops.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
stops.description: Breeding and research centre 10 km north of the centre, with giant pandas in large outdoor enclosures. The group goes at opening time, when pandas are fed and active.
activities: Panda enclosures
Evening hot pot in Chengdu
stops.transport: Taxi or metro line 3 to Panda Avenue

stops.name: Kangding
stops.description: Gateway to the Tibetan plateau at 2,560 m, where the Chengdu road meets the old tea-horse route. A town of Tibetan and Han residents in a narrow river valley; the first night of acclimatisation.
activities: Walk the old town and river
Monasteries on the valley sides
stops.culturalImportance: Historic tea-horse trade town between Sichuan and Tibet
stops.geography: River valley at 2,560 m, snow peaks above
stops.transport: Hired driver from Chengdu via the Ya'an-Kangding expressway, about 3 to 3.5 h
stops.accommodation: Mid-range hotel or guesthouse licensed for foreigners

stops.name: Tagong (Lhagang)
stops.description: Village at about 3,700 m on open grassland below Zhara Lhatse (5,820 m). Lhagang Monastery, with a Jowo Shakyamuni image, is the focus; Khampa herders and pilgrims circle it all day.
activities: Lhagang Monastery and kora
Muya Golden Pagoda
Grassland walk
stops.culturalImportance: Sakya-order monastery and a pilgrimage point of Kham
stops.geography: Grassland plateau, 3,700 m; snow in March
stops.transport: Hired driver from Kangding through the Zheduo tunnel, about 2 to 2.5 h (time not verified)
stops.accommodation: Tibetan family guesthouse, oxygen on request

stops.name: Danba
stops.description: Valley town at about 1,900 m in Gyalrong country, known for stone watchtowers and clustered villages such as Zhonglu and Jiaju on the slopes above the Dadu river.
activities: Villages of Zhonglu and Jiaju
Watchtowers (diaolou)
River walk
stops.culturalImportance: Gyalrong Tibetan villages and stone towers
stops.transport: Hired driver from Tagong, 3 to 4 h (not verified)
stops.accommodation: Family guesthouse in Danba or Zhonglu

stops.name: Xining
stops.description: Capital of Qinghai at 2,275 m on the edge of the Tibetan plateau, with a Hui Muslim quarter, a large mosque and a strong Amdo Tibetan presence. The group arrives from Chengdu by air.
activities: Hui quarter food
Dongguan Great Mosque
stops.culturalImportance: Mix of Hui, Tibetan and Han

stops.name: Kumbum (Ta'er) Monastery
stops.description: Gelug monastery at Huangzhong, 25 km south-west of Xining, birthplace of Tsongkhapa. Named in the French advisory as the one open site in Huangzhong county.
activities: Halls with butter sculptures and murals
Pilgrim path
stops.culturalImportance: One of the six great Gelug monasteries
stops.transport: Taxi or hired car from Xining

stops.name: Tongren (Rebgong)
stops.description: Town in Huangnan Tibetan prefecture, centre of thangka painting. Rongwo and Longwu monasteries stand at either end of the valley and make a lunch stop between Xining and Xiahe.
activities: Rongwo or Longwu monastery
Thangka studios
stops.transport: Hired driver from Xining, about 2.5 h (not verified)

stops.name: Labrang Monastery, Xiahe
stops.description: Gelug monastery founded in 1709, in the Amdo Tibetan town of Xiahe at about 2,900 m. Several hundred monks live here and pilgrims circle the site on a 3 km kora with prayer wheels.
activities: Guided visit of the halls
Kora at dawn
Sangke grassland by car
stops.culturalImportance: Seat of the Jamyang Zhepa line and a major teaching monastery
stops.transport: Hired driver from Tongren, about 2.5 to 3 h
stops.costNote: Hall tickets about CNY 40 plus guide fee

stops.name: Lanzhou West railway station
stops.description: High-speed rail hub 4 h by road from Xiahe. The group changes from car to train here, and the 2 to 3 h ride runs through the Hexi corridor towards Zhangye.
activities: Change from car to high-speed train
stops.transport: High-speed train to Zhangye West (about 2 to 4.5 h depending on train)

stops.name: Zhangye Danxia National Geopark
stops.description: Striped red and yellow sandstone ridges of the Qilian foothills, 40 km from Zhangye. The group goes at first light for colour and quiet.
activities: Sunrise on the viewing platforms
Boardwalks
stops.geography: Hills of Cretaceous red beds at about 1,800 m
stops.transport: Hired car from Zhangye, about 1 to 1.5 h

stops.name: Jiayuguan Pass
stops.description: Ming fortress of 1372 at the western end of the Great Wall, where the Hexi corridor narrows. The Overhanging Great Wall on a steep ridge lies 8 km to the north.
activities: Fort and gate towers
Overhanging Great Wall
stops.culturalImportance: Historic western gate of Ming China
stops.geography: Gobi plain below the Qilian Mountains

stops.name: Dunhuang
stops.description: Oasis town of about 190,000 on the old Silk Road, 25 km from the Mogao Caves and 6 km from the Mingsha dunes.
activities: Night market
Dunhuang museum
stops.geography: Oasis in the Gobi at about 1,140 m
stops.transport: Train from Jiayuguan South, about 2.5 h

stops.name: Mogao Caves
stops.description: UNESCO World Heritage site of Buddhist cave temples cut into a cliff from the 4th century on. Visitors enter in guided groups of selected caves and book the time slot online.
activities: Guided cave visit
Digital exhibition hall
stops.culturalImportance: Greatest surviving Buddhist mural cave complex
stops.transport: Taxi or shuttle from Dunhuang, 30 min

stops.name: Mingsha Shan and Crescent Lake
stops.description: Large dunes about 6 km south of Dunhuang with a spring-fed lake at their foot. In March it is cold and windy but quiet; the walk up the ridge at sunset is the day's outdoor part.
activities: Climb the dune
Sunset

stops.name: Beijing Capital International Airport
stops.description: Return departure airport. The group arrives on a domestic flight from Dunhuang, sleeps near the airport and flies to Paris next morning.
activities: Overnight at an airport hotel
stops.transport: Direct flights to Paris are reported (Air China, Air France); not verified

legs.durationText: ≈ 2 to 4.5 h by high-speed rail to Zhangye West, then 1 to 1.5 h by car

scenarioNotes.realistic: Mid-range guesthouses, 7 driver days, two guide days and the planned entrance fees; headline.
scenarioNotes.comfortable: Better hotels, 8 driver days, private guides, a possible visa and flexible flights.

security.summary: No official source tells foreigners to avoid Sichuan, Gansu or Qinghai, but access to parts of Tibetan Sichuan and Qinghai is subject to short-notice closures. France Diplomatie even lists Xining city as closed to foreigners in a text that is plainly out of date, and the visa-free entry runs only to 31 December 2026. The route leaves out the Tibet Autonomous Region, Xinjiang, Larung Gar and Qinghai Lake for these reasons.
security.assessedRoute: Chengdu, Kangding, Tagong, Danba (Sichuan); Xining, Kumbum, Tongren (Qinghai); Xiahe, Lanzhou, Zhangye, Jiayuguan, Dunhuang (Gansu); Beijing airport. Not assessed: Tibet Autonomous Region, Xinjiang, Aba prefecture (including Jiuzhaigou), Sertar and Larung Gar, Qinghai Lake and Guoluo prefecture.

advisories.level: Green (vigilance normale) for mainland China except Xinjiang (yellow); text restricts access to Ganzi, Aba and Litang around Tibetan New Year and anniversaries, and lists Qinghai counties closed to foreigners
advisories.regionsAffected: Ganzi, Aba, Litang (Sichuan); Xining, Haiyan, Tianjun, Menyuan and other Qinghai counties; Tibet Autonomous Region
advisories.routeImpact: Ganzi (Kangding, Tagong, Danba) can be closed temporarily; Xining and Kumbum are used in practice and the group checks with hotels and guides before travel.

advisories.level: No 'against all travel' or 'all but essential travel' warning for the route regions; regional risk notes for Tibet, Xinjiang and the Myanmar border
advisories.regionsAffected: Tibet; Tibetan Autonomous Prefectures in neighbouring provinces may be restricted; Xinjiang
advisories.routeImpact: Tibetan prefectures on the route (Ganzi, Gannan, Huangnan) may be restricted at short notice; exit-ban and detention warnings apply nationwide.

advisories.level: Yellow for China as a whole
advisories.routeImpact: No orange or red region on the route; Tibetan areas outside the TAR are noted for restrictions.

advisories.regionsAffected: Mainland China (arbitrary detention, exit bans); consular help severely limited in the TAR
advisories.routeImpact: No region of the route has a higher level.

conflictRisk.note: No armed conflict on the route; the FCDO mentions spillover from Myanmar only on the south-west border.

terrorismRisk.note: France Diplomatie rates the risk very low; the FCDO says attacks cannot be ruled out, mainly at transport hubs and holidays.

kidnappingRisk.note: No kidnapping warning for the route in the sources read.

regionalRestrictions: Tibetan areas of Sichuan (Ganzi, Aba, Litang) can be closed to foreigners around Losar (about 7 February 2027) and the March anniversaries (10, 14 and 16 March); the planned dates (19 to 22 March) fall after them but not outside the risk.
Larung Gar in Sertar is closed to foreigners in practice and is not visited.
France Diplomatie's Qinghai list names Xining, Haiyan, Tianjun and other counties as closed to foreigners; Qinghai Lake touches Haiyan and Tianjun and is not in the plan.
Tibet Autonomous Region requires a permit and a guided tour; permits can be withdrawn at short notice; not in the plan.
Xinjiang is not in the plan: France rates it yellow and the FCDO describes widespread arbitrary detentions and phone checks of foreigners.
Hotels must be licensed to host foreigners; some small guesthouses in Tibetan areas are not.
ordinaryRisks: Altitude sickness at Tagong (3,700 m) and Xiahe (2,900 m)
Winter road conditions on the Kangding to Tagong road and between Xining and Xiahe
Cold and wind in Gansu in March
Air pollution in Chengdu and Lanzhou
security.medicalAccess: Good hospitals in Chengdu, Xining, Lanzhou and Beijing; nothing reliable in Tagong or Danba; oxygen is sold at altitude and the closest major hospital to Tagong is in Kangding or Chengdu.
security.insuranceConsiderations: Insurance must cover altitude up to 3,700 m, medical evacuation by road and air and detention-related legal help; check that the policy does not exclude 'Tibetan areas'.
security.reassessmentRequired: Re-check France Diplomatie, the FCDO and Nederland Wereldwijd before booking and two weeks before departure; triggers are any closure order for Ganzi or Qinghai, a Chinese notice on Losar or the March anniversaries, a change in visa-free policy after 31 December 2026, or a new restriction on foreigners in Gansu.

practicalRequirements.visa: French citizens may stay 30 days without a visa until 31 December 2026; no extension to 2027 was announced on 28 November 2026. Other nationalities and rules must be checked with the Chinese embassy; a visa may be needed if the exemption lapses.
practicalRequirements.entry: Passport, a completed arrival form, hotel registration with police within 24 hours (hotels do it); carry the passport at all times.
practicalRequirements.passportValidity: At least six months after arrival and two blank pages (FCDO).
permits: No Tibet Travel Permit for this route (the TAR is not visited)
Mogao Caves reservation required in advance
practicalRequirements.insurance: Policy with altitude to 3,700 m, medical evacuation and legal assistance.
practicalRequirements.connectivity: Google, WhatsApp, Instagram and YouTube are blocked; use a roaming eSIM and a licensed VPN installed before arrival; some Tibetan areas have slow or cut mobile networks.
practicalRequirements.payments: Foreign Visa and Mastercard can be linked to Alipay and WeChat Pay (limit USD 5,000 per transaction); carry some cash for small guesthouses and Tibetan villages.
practicalRequirements.medical: Discuss acetazolamide and altitude with a doctor; routine vaccines; bring prescribed medicines; pharmacies in Chengdu and Xining.
equipment: Sunscreen and lip balm for dry air and UV at altitude
Copies of hotel names in Chinese
Offline maps and a translator app

advantages: No Tibet permit or tour is needed for the route.
Large cultural range: Kham, Amdo, Hui and Silk Road in one loop.
Rail is fast, cheap and punctual.
Mogao and Labrang are far quieter in March than in summer.
disadvantages: Car use is impossible without hired drivers.
Tibetan areas may close without warning.
Cold, wind and altitude make March demanding.
Internet blocks and payment apps need prior setup.
uncertainties: The visa-free policy expires on 31 December 2026 and no extension had been announced on 28 November.
Access to Ganzi, Aba and Qinghai sites may be restricted around the March anniversaries; the France Diplomatie list for Qinghai conflicts with practice.
Mogao and Labrang visiting rules, 2027 ticket prices and the exact Monlam dates were not confirmed from official pages.
Air China's Paris to Chengdu schedule and open-jaw fare are unconfirmed.
